exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix lease-

exec card --actor index-builder lease acquire catalog-snapshot --ttl 17m
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/catalog-snapshot.txt
! stderr .
exec card lease list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/catalog-snapshot.txt
! stderr .
exec card lease show catalog-snapshot
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/catalog-snapshot.txt
! stderr .

-- golden/catalog-snapshot.txt --
catalog-snapshot	index-builder	2026-07-12T12:00:00Z	2026-07-12T12:17:00Z
